# SA Public Sector Salary Scales
## SA Administrative Services Salary Guide by Classification
### ASO 6 Salary — Administrative Services Officer Level 6
AnASO 6 (also written as ASO6 or Administrative Services Officer Level 6) earns **$105,747–$111,854** gross — roughly $80,000–$84,000 take-home after income tax and Medicare, plus12% employer super (~$118,000–$125,000 total package).

## Frequently Asked Questions
### What is the ASO 6 salary?
An Administrative Services ASO 6 (also written as ASO6 or Administrative Services Officer Level 6) earns $105,747 to $111,854 per year as set by the SA Public Sector Enterprise Agreement: Salaried 2026. After income tax and Medicare levy, take-home pay is approximately $80,000–$84,000 per year.
